name: Hotel Vier Jahreszeiten Kempinski München
card: Munich's grand hotel since 1858, on Maximilianstraße.
lead: Munich's grand hotel since 1858, on Maximilianstraße. The natural first or last night of an alpine week: arrive, settle in, and let the city set the tone before the mountains.
facts: On Maximilianstraße since 1858
Rooms and suites up to the presidential suites
The hotel's own Munich Eras programme, described below
why: A calm first night after a long flight, or a last evening in the city before flying home. From here the mountains are a short drive away the next morning.

arranges.title: The Munich Eras, curated by the hotel.
arranges.text: Three Eras designed by the hotel's Resident Curator: Royalty, Adventure and Handmade. For example, a private helicopter morning over five royal castles with the first visit of the day to Hohenschwangau Castle; a run through the English Garden with a football legend; brewing at Munich's second-smallest craft brewery.
arranges.small: A programme of the hotel, delivered by the hotel and its Local Insiders. We build it into your plan.

provider: EverFlow is your contact before and during your stay. The stay itself is provided by Hotel Vier Jahreszeiten Kempinski München (Hotel Vier Jahreszeiten GmbH), and the Munich Eras are the hotel's own programme, under the hotel's terms.

name: Kempinski Hotel Berchtesgaden
card: A thousand metres up, looking out over the Berchtesgaden Alps.
lead: A thousand metres up, looking out over the Berchtesgaden Alps. A hotel for families who want more from winter than downhill skiing: on the days off the slopes, the hotel's Activity Team arranges the outings.
facts: The local winter sports school plans your lessons with you in the hotel lobby: skiing, snowboarding, cross-country and snowshoeing, with full days in the neighbouring Austrian ski areas
Cross-country trails a five-minute drive away, and the 2.3 km natural toboggan run at Hochschwarzeck, reached by chairlift
In summer: e-bike tours to Lake Königssee, golf, and walks to mountain huts
why: For families who want a week with variety: a morning of lessons, an afternoon on the toboggan run, and a hotel that organises the rest.

arranges.title: Activities arranged by the hotel.

arranges.small: The activities are run by the hotel and by the local providers it works with.

name: Rote Wand Gourmet Hotel
card: A hotel known for its cooking, in Zug just outside Lech.
lead: In Zug, the hamlet just outside Lech am Arlberg. A hotel known for its cooking, with the slopes within easy reach: the Zuger Bergbahn gondola takes you from Zug into the Lech Zürs ski area.
facts: 62 rooms and suites, including family suites
Heated indoor and outdoor pool and a 1,500 m² spa
Ski rental, shop and servicing in the hotel
why: For guests who plan the day around lunch and dinner as much as around the snow, and for families who want a quiet base close to the lifts.

arranges.title: Run by the hotel.

name: Alpin Resort Sacher Seefeld
card: Sacher in the mountains: a resort with a 4,700 m² spa on the Seefeld plateau.
lead: Sacher in the mountains. A resort at 1,200 m on the Seefeld plateau, set in its own 20,000 m² natural park, and part of Sacher Hotels since 2022. Innsbruck is half an hour away.
facts: 81 rooms and suites in six categories, from 30 to 95 m²; the Signature suites have their own sauna
A 4,700 m² wellness area with an infinity sports pool and a natural bathing lake with an alpine beach
The toque-awarded restaurant Der Max, and a piece of the original Sacher-Torte
245 km of cross-country trails in the region, right from the plateau
why: For a calm week of cross-country skiing, spa days and long dinners, with gentle slopes close by and Innsbruck for a day in town.

arranges.title: The Sacher Academy For Better Aging.
arranges.text: The hotel's own health programme: a personalised Healthy Longevity programme under medical direction, with diagnostics, treatments and nutrition planned around your stay.
arranges.small: A programme of the hotel, delivered by the hotel's physicians and therapists.

provider: EverFlow is your contact before and during your stay. The stay and the Academy programme are provided by Alpin Resort Sacher Seefeld, under the hotel's terms.

name: Chalets in Megève
card: Twenty-two private chalets and apartments in and around Megève, for 4 to 18 guests.
lead: Private chalets and apartments in Megève: in the village, at Mont d'Arbois and around Le Jaillet, for families and groups of up to 18 guests. Geneva Airport is about an hour away.
facts: Twenty-two houses: twenty chalets and two apartments, for 4 to 18 guests
In the village centre, at Mont d'Arbois and around Le Jaillet; some let you ski back to the door
Many with an indoor pool, a spa or hammam, or a cinema room
Geneva Airport about an hour away by car
why: For families and groups who want a house of their own: one long table, one fireplace, and the village or the slopes a few minutes away.

arranges.title: Service in the house.
arranges.text: A concierge prepares the stay, and private chefs, butlers and ski instructors can be arranged on request.

provider: EverFlow is your contact before and during your stay. Each chalet is provided by its owner through our local partner in Megève; the terms of the house come with your proposal.

card: A boutique hotel on the Schlegelkopf slope: ski-in, ski-out, a few minutes from the centre of Lech.

facts: 10 Top Deluxe Double Rooms and Aurelio Suites, from 55 to 110 m²
More than 1,000 m² of spa, with a 23-metre indoor pool
The Club Chalet: eight rooms for up to 16 guests, with its own spa and indoor pool
At about 1,500 m, directly on the Schlegelkopf slope
why: For guests who want to ski from the door of a small hotel, and for groups who want a chalet of their own with the hotel next door.
provider: EverFlow is your contact before and during your stay. The stay itself is provided by Hotel & Chalet Aurelio, under the hotel's terms.

name: Kempinski Palace Engelberg
card: A Kempinski hotel in the monastery village below the Titlis.
lead: A Kempinski hotel in Engelberg, the monastery village below the Titlis. Set up for ski days: a contact of the ski school in the lobby, a locker in the ski cellar for every room, and boots dried for the next morning.
facts: A contact of the ski school in the hotel lobby; private ski and snowboard instructors arranged in the hotel
Every room has its own locker in the ski cellar, and boots are dried for the next day
A concierge team for information and reservations

name: Schlosshotel Kitzbühel
card: A five-star hotel just above Kitzbühel, with a 3,000 m² spa and its own shuttle to the lifts.
lead: A five-star hotel just above Kitzbühel, a ten-minute walk from the centre. In winter the hotel's own shuttle runs to the cable car valley station; in summer a 9-hole golf course starts at the door.
facts: The Momentum Spa: 3,000 m², with an indoor pool with mountain views and an outdoor pool heated all year
The hotel's own shuttle to the Kitzbühel cable car valley station
A 9-hole golf course on the doorstep
Kitzbühel station 10 minutes away
why: For guests who want the town and the Hahnenkamm close by, and a big spa to come back to.
